options_tabRules_empty.description: Message shown when there are no tab rules yet
options_tabRules_empty.message: Поки що немає додаткових правил. Щоб створити правило, скористайтеся функцією "Додати правило".

options_tabRules_if.description: Label in front of the first tab rule's condition, as in "If URL includes example"

options_tabRules_match.description: Accessible label for the menu choosing whether all or any of a tab rule's conditions must match

options_tabRules_moveDown.description: Accessible label for the button that moves a tab rule down one position

options_tabRules_moveUp.description: Accessible label for the button that moves a tab rule up one position

options_tabRules_or.description: Connector shown between a tab rule's conditions when any one of them can match. Shown in uppercase

options_tabRules_remove.description: Accessible label for the button that removes a tab rule

options_tabRules_removeCondition.description: Accessible label for the button that removes one condition from a tab rule

options_tabRules_save_corral.description: Checkbox label in the tab rule form, shown under the inactive time, that chooses whether tabs auto-closed by the rule are saved to the Tab Corral
options_tabRules_save_corral.message: Зберігати вкладку до списку вкладок після закриття (рекомендовано)

options_tabRules_save_none.description: Note shown in the list of rules under a rule's action when tabs it auto-closes are not saved to the Tab Corral
options_tabRules_save_none.message: Не зберігати до списку вкладок, коли вікно закрите

options_tabRules_then.description: Label in front of a tab rule's action, as in "Then lock tab"

options_tabRules_whitespace.description: Error shown when a tab rule's URL text contains spaces, which never appear in tab URLs
options_tabRules_whitespace.message: Текст URL-адреси не може містити пробілів.

tabLock_lockedReason_else.description: Tooltip for a tab that is locked because it matches no other Tab Rule and the final "Else" rule locks tabs
